incidents.title: CLARKSONS HELLAS – SnP WEEKLY
incidents.description: This week, attacks around Hormuz have reached their highest levels since the war began, with 17 tankers struck so far this month. Diplomacy offers little near-term relief: Iran insists the strait stays closed until its demands are met, while Washington has widened sanctions on Iranian networks. incidents.title: Hormuz Tanker Traffic Rises This Month Even as Attacks Increase
incidents.description: Tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has risen this month, according to data from Vortexa, even as attacks on vessels in the contested waterway have increased.
